text:
Type: spindle-back dining chair
Use: dining, sitting at a table; dining room, kitchen
Style: farmhouse, Scandinavian, traditional
Materials: solid wood with a black stained and lacquered finish
Colors: black, matte charcoal black
Shape: curved top rail over slim vertical spindles, shaped saddle seat, four round splayed legs with stretchers, Windsor-style silhouette, light and open
Feel: graphic, homely, classic, crafted
Goes with: light wood or white tables, white walls, warm wood floors; farmhouse kitchens, Scandinavian or modern country dining rooms

product.name: NORRARYD
product.description: You can easily find your own favourite position thanks to the chair's generous design.
